title: Katie Zacharia admits she never passed legal exam as scrutiny mounts over her past claims of being a lawyer – live
description:
Trump’s new and already under fire press secretary was asked on Fox News if she still had the confidence of the president, to which she said ‘I’m standing here’

  • Sign up for the Breaking News US email

In Maine, Troy Jackson, the Democratic nominee for US Senate, and Susan Collins, the five-term Republican incumbent traded barbs on Thursday in their final debate ahead of the November midterms.

This was the fourth showdown between the pair. Collins has tried to cast Jackson as an inexperienced state lawmaker, and attempted to yolk him to the former nominee, Graham Platner, who dropped out of the race earlier this year following allegations of rape and sexual assault (which he still denies). Meanwhile, Jackson accused his opponent of corruption, and castigated her for her “moderate” persona in Congress.
